title: fix(service-cloud): tmpdir fallback for default data dir on read-only serverless filesystems
body:
- [x] Fix `webcrypto` missing export in studio node polyfill (Vercel studio build)
- [x] Fix `ENOENT: mkdir '/var/task/.objectstack'` cold-start failure on Vercel/Lambda
  - [x] Replace silent `/tmp` SQLite fallback with fail-fast error pointing at `TURSO_DATABASE_URL` (Turso is the default ObjectStack pairing for serverless; ephemeral `/tmp` would silently corrupt data across cold starts)
  - [x] `resolveDefaultDataDir()` throws on Vercel/Lambda/Netlify when `OS_DATA_DIR` is unset
  - [x] `cloud-stack.ts` control-driver default made lazy so `TURSO_DATABASE_URL` / `OS_CONTROL_DATABASE_URL` short-circuit it
  - [x] 15 unit tests cover precedence, throw conditions, and error-message contents
  - [x] `pnpm build` green (51/51 tasks)
  - [x] CHANGELOG entry updated
